description: This file defines the PathOutputCommitProtocol class, which implements a Spark commit protocol for Path Output Committers, handling setup, dynamic partition support, and temporary file creation within Hadoop-based storage systems.

classes.name: PathOutputCommitProtocol
classes.description: A Spark commit protocol class for handling output committers with support for dynamic partitioning and custom temporary file creation.

methods.name: setupCommitter
methods.description: Initializes the committer by interacting with Hadoop factories, with optional fallback to enforce FileOutputCommitter usage.

methods.name: supportsDynamicPartitions
methods.description: Checks if the current committer supports dynamic partitioning capabilities.

methods.name: newTaskTempFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file path for a task, optionally within a subdirectory.

methods.name: newTaskTempFileAbsPath
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with an absolute path, if supported by the committer.
